artist.name: BLÜ EYES
artist.short_description: California artist, writer and producer creating direct, atmospheric alt-pop about difficult feelings and relationships.
artist.biography: BLÜ EYES is the musical identity of Katie Stump, an American singer-songwriter and producer from Fullerton in Orange County, California. In a 2023 interview, she described growing up around family singing and learning piano and guitar as a child. She has cited Taylor Swift and several earlier singer-songwriters as formative influences, alongside more recent alternative-pop artists. Stump works closely with the writing and production of her recordings and has described developing songs from written observations or feelings into melodies and self-produced demos. Her early releases include 'stuck in my head' in 2021 and the 'healing hurts' EP in 2022. She released the album 'The Last Songs I'll Write About You' in 2023 and later discussed its concluding track, 'The Last Song', as a particularly personal example of her creative independence. Subsequent releases have included 'dear anxiety', 'two people at once', and the 2026 project 'Two People at Once'. Her official site presents newer music and videos, while the music-service catalogue distinguishes the 2026 album from an expanded double-album edition. Afterglow positions BLÜ EYES within candid alternative pop, with an emphasis on emotionally direct writing and production; that characterization is editorial. Her catalogue creates a natural discovery path from Rosie Darling and Sasha Alex Sloan toward more expansive, self-produced pop arrangements.
